spans.s:
Meṇṭha
or Bhartṛmeṇṭha Hastipaka. Poet. His verses are q. in anthologies. Patronised by Harṣa an. Mātṛgupta Said to have been the elephant keeper for Harṣa;

-68. Beg. vipadi dhairyamathAbhyudaye kSamA (Sajjana 52). Beg. idaM hi mAhAtmyarvizeSasUcana. Śp. v.. 3594. 3953. Skm. [Page158-b] v.. 564. 576. 852. 1853 (Calcutta edn.). v.. 81-82 (Lahore edn.).
For a. account of his life, etc. see Intro. p.. 92-94 of Sbhv.; also Maha SS. p. 352a.
--Hayagrīvavardha (not extant).
See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛ. Pra. p.. 771-76.
